title: Digit position fold
statement: For a symbol that is a binary digit, update a pair consisting of a position in $\{0,1,2\}$ and a Boolean flag by replacing the position with the smaller of $2$ and one plus its current value, and replacing the flag with its conjunction with the negation of the digit. For every other symbol, leave the pair unchanged.
